Name: Music Please
Author: Skyking2020
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52530/52530-1789684653-475295808.png[/img][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Tired of the silence? Music, Please![/b][/size][size=3]
Music, Please! keeps Stardew Valley's music playing by filling those awkward moments of silence with appropriate vanilla tracks.
The mod listens for genuine silence. If no music is playing for a short time, it chooses a fitting track for your current location, starts it, and then gets out of the way. Stardew gets first choice. Music, Please! just fills the silence.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download and extract Music, Please![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Place the Music, Please! folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]That's it. No configuration is required.[/size]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Keeps music playing during normal gameplay.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Uses vanilla Stardew Valley music — no custom music files.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Detects actual silence instead of constantly overriding the game's music.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Uses appropriate music based on your location.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Supports normal areas such as the Mines, Farm, Town, Forest, Mountains, Beach, Ginger Island, and Bus Stop.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Works alongside Stardew's normal music system rather than trying to replace it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Lightweight, automatic, and requires no configuration.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Stardew Valley 1.6[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]SMAPI 4.5.x or later[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]No other mods are required.[/size]

[size=3]A big thank you to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley and its wonderful soundtrack.[/size]
[size=3]Thanks to the SMAPI team for making mods like this possible, and to the Stardew Valley modding community for years of documentation, testing, experimentation, and shared knowledge.[/size]
[size=3]And thanks to everyone who tested "Music, Please!" and reported the weird little silent corners I missed. 🎵[/size]
